_note: Secret Vault water way back layout, in 1920x1080 pixels. SetColor colours are [r, g, b] from 0 to 1; opacities 0 to 1.

surface._note: the surface line, out of sight below_screen under the screen's bottom when low and at high_y when high

flat._note: the stand-in when the water effect cannot run: the water, and the line along its surface

bubbles._note: a bubble rises from start_below under the screen, margin_x or more from the sides, at a scale from scale_min to scale_max; it is dropped above remove_y or more than remove_below under the screen, and shows only surface_margin below the surface
